mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, conditions are clear at the Verona Public Library with a temperature of 42 degrees. The moon phase is a waxing crescent, and we are expecting an overnight low of 35 degrees with no rain predicted.

The City of Verona has announced that candidate packets for the 2027 Spring Election are now available for all four Aldermanic Districts, with a filing deadline of January 5, 2027. Additionally, the city is continuing its infrastructure improvements, specifically the Military Ridge State Trail paving project and the ongoing reconstruction of Mark Drive.

There is plenty to do in our community this week, including Yoga at Insight Wellness and Art House 360 events tomorrow, followed by Hop Haus Trivia on Thursday and live music at Bailey's Run throughout the weekend.

In a report from October 25, officers responded to the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue, where they arrested a 40-year-old Verona man for a first-offence O W I after finding him asleep at the wheel.

Today's featured flavor was the Chocolate Caramel Twist. As the store is now closed for the night, please join us tomorrow starting at 10:00 AM, when we will be serving up Devil's Food Cake as our featured flavor.
